# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven years old  <sub>[v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair child with a straight nose, gentle and mild hazel eyes, and a "prunes and prisms" mouth. She has long, sleek curls that never fall out of order. She often dresses in a neat, starched white dress with a black sash.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is extraordinarily prim, demure, and composed, remaining quiet and obedient in almost any situation. She is neat, faithful, and industrious, taking great pleasure in helping around the house with tasks appropriate for her age. While systematically reliable and well-behaved, her quiet predictability leads some to view her as somewhat monotonous.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c10 P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c26 P32](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0032), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033)_

## History

Dora was raised by her sickly mother, Mary Joe, alongside her twin brother Davy until their mother's passing. Marilla Cuthbert brought the twins to live at Green Gables, where Dora quickly fit in as a helpful and remarkably composed child who assisted with household chores such as wiping dishes, picking peas, and feeding chickens. When she started attending school, she was initially seated with Mirabel Cotton. During a terrifying hail storm at Green Gables, she remained calm and quiet beside Anne Shirley while others were frightened.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025)_
